scores.note: Even and clear, but the line breaks read staccato ('In your name. And booked them in.'), which lands slightly mechanical. Mid-range pitch, cool rather than warm — closer to a corporate explainer than a night-time film trailer. Not low, not slow, not whispered.

Most natural and conversational of the three in terms of phrasing, but it's bright, brisk and promo-announcer in energy. Reads as a product spot, not an intimate whisper. Clarity is strong; pitch and pace fight the brief outright.

Lowest and softest delivery, genuinely breathy and close to a whisper — the only reel that sits in the right register. Deliberate slow pacing, and the held pause before 'Unmissed' gives it trailer-narrative weight. Slight loss of edge on the quieter words, but the brief asks for intimacy over punch.

why: Eric is the only read that is actually low, slow, close and warm — the cinematic whisper register the brief calls for. Brian is serviceable but cold and choppy; Bill is warm-ish but far too bright and fast for a premium night-time trailer read.
